name: nickseer
description: NickSeer - a beautiful, self-hosted media discovery & request front-end that connects to Plex, Tautulli, Radarr, Sonarr, SABnzbd and Gluetun via API keys, with a smarter recommendation brain, streaming Top 10 rows, IMDb Top 250, IMDb ratings, a rotating hero, 24h auto-refresh and built-in trailers.
